C0796.title: Microsoft Discovers Shai-Hulud 2.0 Cloud-Native Supply Chain Attack
C0796.summary: On December 9, 2025, the Microsoft Defender Security Research Team published analysis of the Shai-Hulud 2.0 supply chain attack. Microsoft said the campaign maliciously modified hundreds of public packages affecting developer environments, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-connected workloads to harvest credentials and configuration secrets, and it provided detection, investigation, and mitigation guidance.
